findings.headline: Migrate this on:event namespace attribute to Solid 2 event handling.
findings.why: Solid 2.0.0-rc.21 removes the on: and oncapture: event namespaces (the compiler rejects them on native elements, and through a spread they become plain attributes); use camelCase event handler attributes or ref callbacks for native listener options.
findings.guidance: Replace on:click with the appropriate camelCase event handler attribute (onClick, onInput, etc.). Solid 2 events are camelCase only (onClick, never onclick, which is now a plain attribute); for capture-phase listeners, custom event names, or native options like passive/once, use a ref callback that calls addEventListener directly.
